punch-hn--punch-classic.description: Punch Clásico is the core of one of the first cigar brands developed in Honduras, combining an Ecuadorian Sumatra wrapper, a Connecticut Broadleaf binder and Honduran, Nicaraguan and Dominican Piloto Cubano filler. Medium-bodied and traditional, it smokes earthy and gently sweet, with cedar and a light pepper; a cigar for coffee or a single malt.

punch-hn--punch-deluxe.description: Punch Deluxe takes the house blend of Honduran, Nicaraguan and Dominican Piloto Cubano filler with a Connecticut Broadleaf binder and an Ecuadorian Sumatra wrapper, also offered in maduro, into a smoother, more refined register. Medium-bodied and easy-drawing, it shows earth and cedar with a balanced spice.

punch-hn--punch-rare-corojo.description: Released each year in limited quantities, Rare Corojo is a box-pressed Honduran Punch wrapped in a reddish Ecuadorian Sumatra leaf from small mountain harvests, over a Connecticut Broadleaf binder and Honduran, Nicaraguan and Dominican Piloto Cubano filler. It smokes medium, with cocoa, coffee, earth and leather and a mild spice.

thirds.notes: Dark chocolate and earth with roasted coffee and a light pepper; one taster found black tea and cedar.
Chocolate steps back for coffee, a hint of almond and a creamy texture, with a grassy, hay-like note.
Leather and toasted nuts move forward, the spice rises slightly and the sweetness carries into the finish.

sources.title: Cigar Inspector – Punch Rare Corojo Champion
Blind Man's Puff – Punch Rare Corojo El Diablo
Half Ashed – Punch Rare Corojo El Diablo review

punch-hn--punch-signature.description: Introduced in 2015 and made at STG Danlí in Honduras, Punch Signature uses an Ecuadorian Corojo wrapper grown for the line, a Connecticut Habano binder and Dominican and Nicaraguan filler. Fuller than the classic Punch, it opens with cedar and sweet pepper, moves through chili-spiced chocolate and finishes on oak and toast.

thirds.notes: Cedar and a sweet, peppery spice, almost like a chili-honey sauce, settling into a nutty almond note.
Toasted cedar and milk chocolate turn into chili-spiced chocolate, the heat present but in proportion.
Oak and cedar lead with toast and almonds, as the strength climbs toward the lower end of full.

punch-hn--punch-diablo.description: Blended by AJ Fernández and rolled at his Tabacalera Fernández, Diablo was the first Punch made outside the brand's Honduran home. A high-primed, four-year-aged Ecuadorian Sumatra oscuro wrapper covers a Connecticut Broadleaf binder and Honduran and Nicaraguan Habano ligero. Full-bodied, it brings dark coffee, earth, cedar and red pepper.

thirds.notes: Spice with licorice and a white-pepper retrohale, plus faint woody, tea-like and fresh-bread notes.
The spice fades to a sweet earthiness, a mocha note appears and a light saltiness touches the lips.
Flavours intensify and linger as the spice returns over sweet earth and a salty finish.

sources.title: Blind Man's Puff – Punch Diablo Scamp

punch-hn--punch-gran-puro.description: One of the first Honduran puros, Gran Puro uses only Honduran tobacco from the San Agustín Valley, finished in a Havana-seed wrapper. It is robust and earthy without overwhelming, with pepper, leather, dried fruit and cinnamon and a long, spicy finish; a cigar for bourbon or cognac.

punch-hn--punch-grand-cru.description: Grand Cru is the milder face of Punch: a silky Connecticut Shade wrapper over a Connecticut Broadleaf binder and well-aged Honduran, Nicaraguan and Dominican Piloto Cubano filler. Smooth and refined, it carries wood and spice with a touch of licorice and a floral, herbal aroma, a cigar to take slowly.

punch-hn--punch-golden-era.description: Golden Era is an all-Corojo Punch, made from Honduran-grown Cuban-seed Corojo and Habano from the Eiroa family's farms and rolled at Fábrica de Puros Aladino in Danlí. Released in 2023, it is balanced and medium, with creamy nuts and oak, caramel sweetness, honey and a gentle baking spice.

thirds.notes: Caramel sweetness, then nuts, honey and leather as the smoke turns creamy; strength starts on the mild side.
Nuts and oak form the base, with brown sugar, hay, cinnamon and a light white pepper on the finish.
Caramel and floral notes with cinnamon and earth, the flavours merging into a sweet, woody, nutty whole.

sources.title: Cigar Czars – Punch Golden Era review
Blind Man's Puff – Punch Golden Era Robusto
Famous Smoke – Punch Golden Era review

punch-hn--punch-knuckle-buster.description: Launched in 2020 as an everyday Punch, Knuckle Buster is rolled in Danlí, Honduras, from a Nicaraguan Habano wrapper and binder over Nicaraguan and Honduran Habano filler. Medium and straightforward, it offers natural tobacco sweetness, honey-roasted nuts, caramel and earth with a building white pepper.

thirds.notes: Sweet honey and peanut with a salty edge, earth and wood, and pepper that ranges from faint to bold.
Citrus and a ginger-like spice appear; the nutty caramel turns more leathery as white pepper builds.
Leather leads, with a pencil-lead note and some honey-roasted nut; the spice rises at the close.
